title: VPN connection does not provide any details when it fails to connect
line: When a VPN fails to connect, its notification now has a Show Log button that shows why it failed.
explanation: NetworkManager only reports a short reason code when a VPN fails; the plugin's own messages (bad certificate, TLS or auth errors) only go to NetworkManager's journal, so the notification just said the connection failed to activate. kded now remembers when each VPN activation started and, when it fails, reads NetworkManager.service's journal entries since then with journalctl. If there are any, the failure notification gets a Show Log button that opens a simple read-only dialog with those lines.

commits.message:
kded: offer the VPN's log when a VPN connection fails to activate

NetworkManager doesn't say why a VPN plugin failed, so the notification
only said that the connection failed. It now has a Show Log button that
shows what NetworkManager and the VPN plugin logged during the attempt.

BUG: 496888

media.caption: Pure master: a failed VPN only says it failed to activate
With the fix: the same notification has a Show Log button
Show Log opens what NetworkManager and nm-openvpn logged during the attempt (here an expired server certificate)
